title: Crop Disease Diagnosis System Empowering Sri Lankan Farmers through Digital Technologies
features:
1. Automated leaf disease detection using trained CNN models
  2. Accuracy of 96.2% (training) and 94.2% (validation) across 48 leaf classes
  3. Disease prediction with corresponding treatment recommendations
  4. Centralized dashboard for monitoring predictions and analytics
  5. Flask-based machine learning backend integrated with a responsive React.js frontend
  6. Optimized database and API for image storage, prediction logs, and analytics
description:
Developed a machine learning powered crop disease diagnosis system to assist Sri Lankan farmers in early detection and treatment of plant diseases through image-based classification. The system analyzes uploaded leaf images, predicts the disease category using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), and provides relevant remedies through an interactive web platform.

The project focused on enhancing agricultural productivity and sustainability by bridging the technological gap between farmers and digital tools, offering real time insights, automated disease identification, and statistical analytics for improved crop management.
